#Part 1
1.Open the sleep dataset in R 
```{r}
View(sleep)
```

2. Is it long or wide format? How do you know? 
```{r}
#It is in long format because thee are 3 columns across and 20 rows down. Therefore the majority of the data length is going down.
```

3. Transform this data so that it is in the other format. 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
sleepDataWide <- sleep |> pivot_wider(id_cols = c("group"), names_from = "ID",values_from = "extra")
```

4. Transform your data back to its original format. 
```{r}
sleepDataLong <- pivot_longer(sleepDataWide, cols = (2:11), names_to = "ID", values_to = "extra")
```

5. Open the Starwars dataset
```{r}
View(starwars)
```

6. Create homeworld as a factor. How many levels does it have? 
```{r}
starwarsHomeworld <- as.factor(starwars$homeworld)
levels(starwarsHomeworld)
#48 levels
```

7. Reorder homeworld so that Naboo is the reference group. 
```{r}
starwarsHomeworld <- relevel(starwarsHomeworld, ref = "Naboo")
```

8. Use mutate to create a column transforming kg to pounds. (hint: you may need to look up the conversion)
```{r}
starwarsPounds <- starwars %>% mutate(massLbs = mass * 2.20462262)
```

9. Print a summary of your column from #8
```{r}
summary(starwarsPounds$massLbs)
```


#Part 2
10. open the billboard dataset.
```{r}
View(billboard)
```

11. are the data in this dataframe in long or wide format? explain how you know. 
```{r}
#This data is in wide format because there are 79 columns across and 317 rows down
```

12. change the data from its original format to the other version. 
```{r}
billboardLong <- billboard |> pivot_longer(cols= colnames(billboard)[4:79], names_to= "week", values_to="rank", values_drop_na = TRUE) 

```

13. change it from your altered version in #3 back to its original state. 
```{r}
billboardWide <- billboardLong |> pivot_wider(id_cols = c("artist", "track", "date.entered"), names_from = "week", values_from = "rank")
```

14. Separate the date entered column into three columns: one for year, one for month, and one for day. 
```{r}
billboardWide |> separate(date.entered, into= c("year", "month", "day"), sep= "-")
```
